name: rea-video
description: Reverse-engineer any video, shot by shot: filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Breakdowns in the open VIDEO.md format. 逆向一切视频，逐个镜头看是拍的、AI 生成的还是代码做的，再告诉你怎么复刻；拆解结果按 VIDEO.md 格式输出。
readme: Shot by shot: was it filmed, AI-generated or coded, and how to remake it. Every breakdown is written in VIDEO.md, an open format that agents read layer by layer. Left: a TikTok ad shot on a phone. Right: an AI remake with another product. rea-video's verdict: the left is all live footage, one set and two camera positions; the right is all AI, 8 shots across 3 generations.
